text:
incident-bot: Pager: spike in 5xx for /v1/chat (region: na-east). Alert=api-gateway:5xx-spike
Marta: I'm the oncall lead, taking this. Noted surge starting ~2026-03-15T18:00Z.
Evan SRE: Edge logs show lots of TLS handshake failures and immediate 502/525 responses coming from multiple Cloudflare POPs in na-east and central.
Jun Eng: Any recent TLS param pushes or cert rotations?
Evan SRE: No cert rotations from us. Samples:
```
2026-03-15T18:02:13Z pop=cf-na-east-1 level=error msg="tls handshake aborted" err="tls: unsupported protocol" sni=api.redwood.com
2026-03-15T18:02:14Z pop=cf-na-east-2 level=warn msg="upstream timeout" err="524: origin unreachable"
```
Tory Support: Multiple customers reporting failed requests and retries piling up. Some see immediate 502, others timeouts.
Cloudflare Status: We're aware of a partial edge regression affecting TLS negotiation in several NA POPs. Engineers are rolling a fix/rollback. Incident ref: CF-2026-EDGE-994. https://status.cloudflare.com/summary/CF-2026-EDGE-994
Marta: Impact assessment: client requests intermittently fail with 5xx—estimated 25-70% depending on client geolocation and ISP. High-volume tenants in eastern US affected.
Evan SRE: Proposed mitigations: 1) Shift traffic weights away from affected POPs (smart-routing), 2) Enable our fallback CDN (multi-cdn), 3) Temporarily reduce client retries and connection reuse, 4) Enable origin-bypass path for VIP customers via direct-signed IP route.
Jun Eng: Origin-bypass? That requires short-lived IP allowlist updates and adjusted origin routing. Risky but fastest for a small subset.
Marta: Priorities: protect latency-sensitive customers and reduce error amplification. Evan, apply routing changes. Jun, prep origin-bypass for top-10 tenants if needed. Tory, prepare status message. Pause non-essential deploys.
deploy-bot: deploys paused for api-prod* by request of Marta.
Evan SRE: Executing routing swap: deweight cf-na-east-* and bump us-west/eu-west. Canary first.
```
# rwdctl routing set-weight --pop cf-na-east-1:0.1,cf-na-east-2:0.1 --region-preference us-west-2,eu-west-1 --canary 5%
```
Evan SRE: Canary shows drop in 5xx from 42% -> 15% for canary traffic. Applying full change.
Tory Support: Draft for status page: "We are investigating increased 5xx and TLS handshake failures affecting API reachability for customers in eastern North America. Working with our CDN provider and applying traffic routing mitigations. We will provide updates every 30 minutes." Approve to post?
Marta: Post now. Call out endpoints (/v1/chat, /v1/stream) and note bank-of-accounts customers will get direct outreach.
Tory Support: Posted and alerted top-50 customers via email.
Evan SRE: Cloudflare opened ticket CF-INC-994; they're rolling back a config that touched TLS policies. They've requested TLS handshakes (SNI, cipher suite) and edge request IDs. Attached logs to ticket.
Jun Eng: Preparing origin-bypass play: create temporary ACL for backup-ips and issue direct-ingress cert to accept host header. Estimated time ~10-15m to stand up for 5 tenants.
DNS Ops: TTL for api.redwood.com reduced to 30s; backup CNAME backup-cdn.redwood.net already in place. We can flip if rollback stalls.
Evan SRE: Also enabling a soft-failure policy in gateway to return 429 for noisy clients to reduce retries.
```
# feature flag
ffctl set api.client.max_retries 1 --scope production --expires 2026-03-15T21:00Z
```
Marta: After routing change and rate-limits, system 5xx dropped to ~3% overall. Some residual TLS handshake spikes remain at isolated POPs. Cloudflare says rollback completed for some POPs at 18:25Z and full propagation ongoing.
Tory Support: Update posted: "Mitigations in place; partial recovery observed. Continuing to monitor. No evidence of data loss or auth-only errors at this time."
Evan SRE: Requesting next steps from Cloudflare: share post-rollback validation plan and root cause once available. Also recommend we run multi-CDN failover test in next sprint.
Cloudflare Status: Follow-up: rollback is in progress, propagation may take up to 45 minutes. We'll update CF-INC-994 when done.
Keisha oncall: Taking handoff at 18:30Z. Outstanding: monitor 5xx and TLS handshake metrics, confirm Cloudflare ticket closed or POPs stable, validate origin bypass status for tenants, and unpause deploys once stable.
Marta: Confirm handoff. We'll draft RCA and assign owners: Evan for routing/CDN mitigation artifacts, Jun for origin compatibility and bypass docs, DNS Ops for multi-cdn runbook and TTL strategy, Tory for customer comms and postmortem notice.
Tory Support: Noted. Scheduling RCA meeting tomorrow.
Keisha oncall: Ack. I'll continue monitoring and will flip backup-CNAME only if errors reappear or rollback doesn't finish.
Marta: Incident state -> mitigated (partial). Closing Slack incident thread for live mitigation; will reopen for RCA prep if needed. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
